༄༅/ /sgrub dkyil 'dod 'jo kha bsgyur te dril bu lha lnga bya ba'i nyer mkho bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sgrub dkyil 'dod 'jo kha bsgyur te dril bu lha lnga bya ba'i nyer mkho bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ sgrub thabs don gnyis 'dod 'jo kha bsgyur nas dril bu lha lnga nyams su blang bar 'dod na/ gzhan rnams sgrub thabs ltar la/ tshogs zhing gi/ rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal// gyi rjes su/ bgrod dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las// bdag gis 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// bdag ni rang nyid skad cig ma// sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bya// zhes dang*/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las byung ba'i yul drug gi lha mos mchod par gyur/ oṃ āḥbadzra ā darshe hūm̐/ de bzhin a darsha'i gnas su/ wī ṇi/ gandhe/ ra se/ sparshe/ dharme/ zhes phyi mchod/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhis bdud rtsi thogs nas mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba badzra kā mi ni sarba bhakṣaṃ sho dhā ya gu hya badzra nī swā hā/ zhes mtheb srin gyis 'bul ba nang mchod/ tshogs zhing gi lha yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas lha thams cad bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur par bsams pa gsang mchod/ de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi rjes su/ sems can kun gyi sgrib pa bsal bya'i phyir// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs bzhugs pa'i rgyal rnams la// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bdag bskul lo// rgyal ba gang dag mya ngan 'da' bzhed rnams// 'gro la phan phyir bskal pa zhing rdul gyi// grangs snyed mya ngan mi 'dar gsol ba 'debs// sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal de rgyu bcas dang rab bral zhing*// thob zin bde ba che dang mi 'bral bar// nyon mongs bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas shog /ces dang*/ yig brgya brjod/ tshogs zhing rnams rang gi smin mtshams su thim par gyur par bsam pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs so// de nas/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa med la/ kun rtog gis btags pa tsam gyis sgyu ma lta bur gyur/

oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis brtan g.yo thams cad sbyangs te 'od du gyur pa rang la bsdu zhing*/ rang yang stod smad nas 'od du gyur pa thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim| hūm̐ yig ū ha la/ ha mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ nā da yang shin tu phra ba las mi dmigs par gyur/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ chos thams cad rab tu gnas pa med pa nam mkha' dri ma med pa lta bu'i 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur par gsal ba ni ye shes kyi tshogs so// slar yang de ltar snang ba thams cad bsdus pa'i stong pa nyid las langs te/ rang gi sems nā da'i gzugs gyen du bsgrengs pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa nam mkhar gnas pa/ de'i 'od kyis e las chos 'byung dkar po zhes pa nas/ nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du zhes pa'i bar gzhung ltar la/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog dang rtsa zhal nag po/ zhal lhag ma g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa 'jigs su rung ba/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i phreng ba gnyis kyis sbrel ba'i thod skam lnga lnga rin po che'i rtse phran can skra mtshams su bcings pa/ ral pa'i cod pan spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor nor bu/ mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon du zla ba phyed pas spras pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu thugs kar bsnol bas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis glang po'i pags pa mgo g.yas su phyogs pa'i lag pa dang rkang pa g.yon pa nas bzung ste mnabs pa/ g.yas gsum pas thod pa'i ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pas dgra sta/ lnga pas gri gug /drug pas tri shū la/ g.yon gsum pas kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhi pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pas rdo rje'i zhags pa/

drug pas tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ mi rus kyi 'khor lo/ rna cha/ mgul rgyan| gdub kor/ ska rags rnams so sor 'chang zhing*/ thal chen gyis byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i mgo rlon khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang zhing*| stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal sbyar/ g.yas 'og ma ḍā ru/ g.yon 'og ma ral gri 'dzin pa'i mgo bo dang*/ g.yon bskums pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo lag pa bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal sbyar/ 'og ma gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin pa'i nu ma brdzis pa/ 'jigs dus gnyis ka gdong gcig /mig gsum/ phyag rgya lnga 'chang ba/ bcom ldan 'das/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa// dgod pa drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ */snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ */ gar dgu'i nyam dang ldan pa'o// de'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ spyan gsum skra grol ba/ gcer mo thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ thod pa'i dum bu'i ska rags la 'og pag sogs 'khrol ba/ thal ba spangs ba'i phyag rgya lngas spras shing*/ phyag g.yon gdug pa'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thogs nas yab kyi mgul la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis ma rungs pa rnams sdig par mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yon yab kyi g.yas dang lhan cig tu brkyang zhing*| g.yas kyi byin pas yab kyi brla g.yon pa'i steng nas 'khril ba/ yab yum bde ba chen po'i nyams rgyas shing bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po zhes pa nas/ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur gyi bar bya/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma la mdun du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ g.yon du rab mdzes ma ljang gu/ rgyab tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ g.yas su gzugs can ma ser mo/

bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig /spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal can/ gcer mo skra grol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ thod pa'i dum bu'i ska rags la 'og pag sogs 'khrol ba/ thal ba spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas spras pa phyag g.yas dang pos gri gug /g.yon dang pos thod khrag /g.yas gnyis pas cang te'u/ g.yon gnyis pas kha ṭwāṃ ga thogs pa/ zla ba dang dbugs bral gyi gdan la g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i gar gyis gnas pa/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du sha lngas gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur par mos/ de nas/ lus rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o// zhes pa nas/ hūm̐ nag pos mtshan par gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ de nas 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma sogs dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang*/ dbang gi lha gdan gsum tshang ba dang phyi nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ phyir 'brang gi bgegs thams cad/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bgegs bskrad/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra satkā raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hās mchod yon dang*/ oṃ āḥbadzra ā darshe hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ wī ṇi/ gandhe/ ra se/ sparshe/ dharme/ sbyar bas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa la dgug gzhug bcing mnyes par byas pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ rnam lnga 'dod kor dang bcas/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes mthar 'khyud tshul yang bya/ chos thams cad thabs shes dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor du dag la bdag kyang de'i ngo bor dag go// zhes nga rgyal bzung*/

dbang ltar/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// zhes pa nas/ dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ de rjes rig ma bcu drug gis mchod pa'i gong du bshad pa'i yul drug gi lha mos mchod/ rig ma bcu drug gi rjes su/ oṃ sarba bi shwastha pra sa ra pū dza me gha sa mu dre ā hūm̐/ zhes pas 'dod yon dpag tu med pas kyang mchod/ de rjes/ bcom ldan 'das dang rnal 'byor ma lnga'i ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse gsum pa nas 'bru tsam sbu gu can gyis bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bas tshim par gyur/ oṃ a mṛ ta u da ka hūm̐ hūm̐ ṭha ṭhaḥ trāṃ a khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ mchod do/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas nas/ oṃ sarba dharma pā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ da sha diklo ka pā la sa pa ri wā rā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bhū ta sa pa ri wā rā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes thigs gtor phul nas| oṃ a mṛ ta swā da swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi myang*/ de rjes/ bcom ldan 'das kyi lte bar oṃ badzra bai ro= snying gar oṃ sarba buddha= mgrin par oṃ shrī badzra= dpral bar oṃ hrīḥ= yum gyi lte bar oṃ shrī= snying gar oṃ hrīḥ= mgrin par oṃ badzra bai ro= dpral bar oṃ sarba= rnams gsal btab nas/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las zhes pa nas/ lha thams cad lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba nyams su myong zhing thams cad he ru ka'i cha shas tsam du zad pa'i phyir ro// zhes yun ring du gsang mchod la dmigs pa gal che ste/ dril bu pas gsang ba phyag rgya'i mchod pa 'di dngos grub myur du thob byed kyi thabs kyi gtso bor gsungs so// de nas/ rang bzhin med pa'i gnas goms pa// sogs de kho na'i mchod pa man chad rnams sgrub thabs don gnyis 'dod 'jo dkyus ltar byas pas grub pa na bdag gi rnal 'byor gyi skabs so// bum bskyed la ni rnam rgyal gyi lha rnams zhal phyag 'dir gong du bshad pa ltar dang*/

las bum du dum skyes ma yang phyag bzhi ma la rgyan phyag mtshan sogs rnal 'byor ma bzhi ltar bskyed/ spyan 'dren pa nas rgyas 'debs bar dkyil chog ltar mchod pa'i skabs rig ma bcu drug gi sngon der/ gzugs ma sgra ma dri ro ma// reg ma chos ma zhi ba ma// me long pi wang dri ro reg /chos 'byung thogs pa sprul te mchod// oṃ āḥbadzra ā darshe hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ wī ṇi/ gandhe/ ra se/ sparshe/ dharme/ zhes yul drug gi lha mo bcug /de phyin dkyil chog dkyus ltar bya/ mdun bskyed la'ang lha lnga po zhal dang phyag gong ltar bsgyur/ mchod pa'i rig ma bcu drug gi gong der/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las yul drug gi lha mo spros te dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur par mos/ yul gzugs rnam dag dkar mo yid 'phrog ma// phyag bzhi me long cang te padma'i snod| |kha ṭwāṃ thogs pa mkha' khyab tshogs spros pas// khrag 'thung 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod// oṃ āḥbadzra ā darshe hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ yul sgra rnam dag sngon mo yid 'phrog ma| |phyag bzhi pi wang cang te'u padma'i snod// kha ṭwāṃ thogs pa mkha' khyab tshogs spros pas// khrag 'thung 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod// oṃ āḥbadzra wī ṇi hūm̐/ yul dri rnam dag ser mo yid 'phrog ma// phyag bzhi dri mchog cang te'u padma'i snod// kha ṭwāṃ thogs pa mkha' khyab tshogs spros pas// khrag 'thung 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod// oṃ āḥbadzra gandhe hūm̐/ yul ro rnam dag dmar mo yid 'phrog ma// phyag bzhi ro mchog cang te'u padma'i snod// kha ṭwāṃ thogs pa mkha' khyab tshogs spros pas// khrag 'thung 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod// oṃ āḥbadzra ra se hūm̐/ yul reg rnam dag ljang mo yid 'phrog ma// phyag bzhi na bza' cang te'u padma'i snod// kha ṭwāṃ thogs pa mkha' khyab tshogs spros pas// khrag 'thung 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod// oṃ āḥbadzra sparshe hūm̐/

yul chos rnam dag dkar mo yid 'phrog ma// phyag bzhi chos 'byung cang te'u padma'i snod// kha ṭwāṃ thogs pa mkha' khyab tshogs spros pas// khrag 'thung 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod// oṃ āḥbadzra dharme hūm̐/ zhes nang mchod dang*/ gsang mchod kyi khyad par gong du bdag bskyed kyi skabs bshad pa ltar bsgyur/ de kho na'i mchod pa sogs dkyil chog ltar dang*/ bstod pa/ chos kyi dbyings la nas/ khros la phyag 'tshal bstod kyi bar dor ba'i mal/ oṃ/ bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug nas/ dbang phyug ma la bstod kyi bar rkang brgyad gnyis bcug pa'i mthar/ zhi rgyas dbang dang sogs dkyil mchog dkyus kho na byas pas 'grub bo// gzhan yang dbang gi skabs gtso bo zhal gcig /byin rlabs kyi sngon du yab yum gyi gnas bzhir sngags bzhi 'god pa gong gi bdag bskyed kyi gsang mchod skabs ltar sbyar/ de tsam gyis sgrub thabs don gnyis 'dod 'jo dkyil chog dang bcas pa kha bsgyur bas dril bu lha lnga 'khrul pa dang bral ba nges par 'grub pa/ dril bu lha lngar tshogs zhing srung 'khor gyi sngon du bya bar gsungs 'dug pas spro na/ gong 'og brje bar bya la/ mi spro na de tsam snga phyi'i go rim ma gtogs nyams len gyi gnas 'phyugs par mi 'gro bas ma brjes kyang nges par skyon med do// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
